title: Rhymetime at Glebe Library - 0 to 2 Years
description: A fun 20-minute session of singing and rhymes for babies and toddlers aged 0–2 years and their carers at Glebe Library. No bookings required.
longDescription:
Rhymetime at Glebe Library is a free weekly session designed especially for babies and toddlers aged 0–2 years and their carers. The 20-minute program fosters a love of reading and helps develop important early literacy skills and social interaction. Sessions start promptly at 10:30am during school term - no bookings required, just arrive a little early.

* Free entry - no bookings required
* Builds early literacy skills through singing and fingerplay
* A wonderful way for babies and toddlers to socialise
* Runs weekly during school term (no sessions during NSW school or public holidays)
* Sessions start promptly at 10:30am - please allow time for arrival

title: Storytime at Surry Hills Library - 3 to 5 Years
description: A free weekly 30-minute storytelling session for children aged 3–5 years and their carers at Surry Hills Library, combining stories and songs to build early literacy skills ready for school.
longDescription:
Storytime at Surry Hills Library is a free, fun and interactive 30-minute session for pre-schoolers aged 3–5 years and their carers. Each week, children enjoy stories and songs that foster a love of reading and develop the early literacy skills and social interaction they need before starting school. Sessions start promptly at 11:30am - no bookings required.

* Free entry - no bookings required
* Stories and songs to build early literacy and school-readiness
* Encourages social interaction and a lifelong love of reading
* 30-minute sessions starting promptly at 11:30am
* Weekly during school term (no sessions during NSW school or public holidays)

seoDescription: Free weekly storytime for pre-schoolers 3–5 at Surry Hills Library. Stories and songs every week during school term at 11:30am.

description: A free weekly 30-minute storytelling session for children aged 3–5 years and their carers at Glebe Library every Thursday, featuring stories and songs.
longDescription:
Storytime at Glebe Library is a free weekly session held every Thursday for pre-schoolers aged 3–5 years and their carers. The 30-minute sessions combine reading stories and singing songs to foster a love of reading and develop the early literacy skills children need before starting school. * Weekly Thursdays during school term
* Stories and songs for pre-schoolers aged 3 to 5
* Builds school-readiness literacy and social skills
* 30-minute sessions - please arrive promptly

title: Storytime at Green Square Library - 3 to 5 Years

title: Bilingual Storytime at Darling Square Library - English & Mandarin, 3 to 5 Years
description: A free weekly 30-minute bilingual storytelling session in English and Mandarin for children aged 3–5 years - supporting early literacy and a wonderful cultural exchange.
longDescription:
Bilingual Storytime at Darling Square Library is a free weekly session for pre-schoolers aged 3–5 years and their carers. Stories, songs and rhymes are delivered in both English and Mandarin, supporting early literacy development, nurturing Mandarin language knowledge, and providing a wonderful cultural exchange for the whole family. Sessions start promptly at 11:30am and run for 30 minutes during school term. No bookings required.

* Free entry - no bookings required
* Stories, songs and rhymes in both English and Mandarin
* Supports early literacy and Mandarin language development
* A wonderful cultural exchange for the whole family
* Weekly during school term - sessions start promptly at 11:30am
address: 1 Little Pier Street (Level 1–2, Darling Exchange Building), Haymarket NSW 2000

seoDescription: Free weekly bilingual storytime in English and Mandarin for pre-schoolers 3–5 at Darling Square Library. Nurtures language skills and cultural exchange.

title: Auslan & English Storytime at Glebe Library
description: A free fortnightly bilingual storytime in Auslan and English for deaf and hearing children aged 3–5 years, presented by Glebe Library and Deaf Connect on Saturday mornings.
longDescription:
Auslan and English Storytime at Glebe Library is a free, inclusive fortnightly session presented by library staff and Deaf Connect. Designed for both deaf and hearing children aged 3–5 years, the session fosters a love of reading and develops literacy skills and social interaction. Stories are told in both Auslan and English. Sessions run on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of each month during school term, from 11:30am to 12:00pm. No bookings required but numbers are limited - arrive early to secure your place. Parents and guardians must stay during the session.

* Free entry - no bookings required (arrive early, numbers are limited)
* Welcoming for both deaf and hearing children aged 3–5
* Stories in Auslan and English, presented with Deaf Connect
* Builds literacy skills and encourages social interaction
* Fortnightly Saturdays (2nd and 4th of each month) during school term
seoTitle: Auslan & English Storytime Glebe Library | Free Inclusive Pre-schooler Activity | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Free fortnightly bilingual storytime in Auslan and English for deaf and hearing children 3–5 at Glebe Library. Presented with Deaf Connect on Saturday mornings.

title: Rainbow Families Storytime at Kings Cross Library - 0 to 5 Years
description: An inclusive storytime for children aged 0–5 years and their carers at Kings Cross Library, celebrating Mardi Gras with LGBTIQA+-themed stories of love, family and community - followed by a craft activity.
longDescription:
Rainbow Families Storytime at Kings Cross Library is a free, inclusive event for children aged 0–5 years and their carers, celebrating Mardi Gras through the joy of storytelling. Led by library staff, the session features LGBTIQA+-themed stories exploring themes of love, family, community and friendship - followed by a fun craft activity for everyone. A warm, welcoming session for all families.

* Free entry - open to all families
* LGBTIQA+-themed stories of love, family, community and friendship
* Celebrates Mardi Gras with an inclusive, joyful atmosphere
* Followed by a creative craft activity for children
* Suitable for children aged 0–5 years and their carers
seoTitle: Rainbow Families Storytime Kings Cross Library | Free Inclusive Family Activity Sydney | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Free inclusive storytime for 0–5 year olds at Kings Cross Library celebrating Mardi Gras. LGBTIQA+ themed stories plus craft activity. All families welcome.

title: School Holidays: Pop-up Book Houses - 5 to 8 Years, Kings Cross
description: A free hands-on workshop where children aged 5–8 learn to create their own three-dimensional pop-up book that unfolds into a miniature dollhouse - all materials provided, bookings essential.
longDescription:
Pop-up Book Houses is a free school holiday workshop at Kings Cross Library where children aged 5–8 learn to create their very own three-dimensional pop-up book that unfolds into a miniature dollhouse. Led by library staff, every material, tool and step of guidance is included. Places are limited so bookings are essential. Parents and guardians must sign in and stay within the library for the duration of the activity.

* Free entry - bookings essential (places are limited)
* Children create their own 3D pop-up book that unfolds into a dollhouse
* All materials, tools and guidance provided by library staff
* Suitable for children aged 5–8 years
* Parents or guardians must stay within the library space
seoTitle: School Holidays Pop-up Book Houses Kings Cross | Free Kids Workshop Sydney | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Free school holiday workshop for kids 5–8 at Kings Cross Library - create your own 3D pop-up book that unfolds into a dollhouse. All materials included. Book now.

title: School Holidays: Maker and Creator - 8 to 12 Years, Darling Square
description: A free two-hour school holiday workshop at Darling Square Library's makerspace where kids aged 8–12 get hands-on with Spheros, Ozobots, Edison robots, wind tubes and LED circuits.
longDescription:
Maker and Creator is a free two-hour school holiday workshop at the Darling Square Library makerspace, designed for curious kids aged 8–12. Children get hands-on with the latest makerspace kits and electronic gadgets, with different activities each session. Expect robot battles with Edison bots, Sphero and Ozobot challenges, wind tube experiments and LED circuit building with conductive tape. Parents and guardians must stay within the library during the session.

* Free entry - check the event page for available session dates
* Hands-on with Spheros, Ozobots, Edison robots and more
* Battle it out with robots and light up LEDs using conductive tape
* Make things fly in the wind tube - different activities each session
* Parents or guardians must stay within the library space
address: 1 Little Pier Street (Level 1–2, Darling Exchange Building), Haymarket NSW 2000
time: 2-hour sessions - check event page for dates
seoTitle: School Holidays Maker and Creator Darling Square | Free Kids STEM Workshop Sydney | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Free school holiday maker workshop for kids 8–12 at Darling Square Library. Robots, Spheros, Ozobots, wind tubes and LEDs - a hands-on STEM adventure.

title: School Holidays: Creative Coding - Code & Create, 8 to 12 Years
description: A free beginner coding workshop at Darling Square Library where kids aged 8–12 use code to create their own computer-generated printable artwork - no experience needed.
longDescription:
Creative Coding: Code & Create is a free school holiday workshop at the Darling Square Library Makerspace for kids aged 8–12. This beginner-level session, led by experienced creative coder Jared Berghold, introduces fundamental coding skills through making. Participants use code to generate their own printable artwork they take home. No prior coding experience required. Parents and guardians must stay within the library.

* Free entry - check the event page for available session dates
* Beginner-friendly - no coding experience required
* Led by Jared Berghold, a creative coder with 15+ years of experience
* Kids use code to generate printable artwork to take home
* Parents or guardians must stay within the library space
address: 1 Little Pier Street (Level 1–2, Darling Exchange Building), Haymarket NSW 2000
time: Check event page for session dates and times
seoTitle: School Holidays Creative Coding Darling Square | Free Kids Coding Workshop Sydney | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Free beginner coding workshop for kids 8–12 at Darling Square Library. Use code to create printable artwork - led by creative coder Jared Berghold.

title: PCYC School Holiday Activities - City of Sydney
description: Safe, fun and affordable full-day school holiday programs for school-aged children at PCYC Woolloomooloo - sport, arts, crafts, coding, laser tag and more. Active and Creative Kids vouchers accepted.
longDescription:
PCYC City of Sydney runs structured full-day and half-day school holiday programs for school-aged children at their Woolloomooloo centre. Programs are delivered by qualified coaches and cover a wide range of activities including laser tag, multi-sport, gymnastics, boxing, painting, dance, crafts, coding and skateboarding. Active and Creative Kids vouchers are accepted for eligible activities. Located opposite the Domain Carpark in the heart of the city.

* Full day program: 9am–3pm (drop-off from 8am, pick-up until 4pm)
* Wide variety of activities: laser tag, gymnastics, boxing, coding, skateboarding and more
* Run by qualified coaches with experience working with young people
* Active and Creative Kids vouchers accepted
* Suitable for primary and high school aged children
seoTitle: PCYC School Holiday Activities Woolloomooloo | Kids Holiday Program Sydney | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Full and half-day school holiday programs at PCYC Woolloomooloo - sport, arts, coding and more for school-aged kids. Active & Creative Kids vouchers accepted.

title: Tech & Creative Holiday Camps for Ages 5 to 12 - Code Camp
description: Code Camp runs week-long in-person holiday camps for children aged 5–12 covering coding, robotics, stop-motion animation, DJing and more at Sydney locations.
longDescription:
Code Camp inspires kids to get creative with technology these holidays. Children learn valuable new skills, have loads of fun and make new friends through a wide range of in-person camps, including coding, robotics, stop-motion animation, DJing and more. Popular programs include Minecraft Engineers (ages 7–12), Minecraft Minis (ages 5–7), Roblox Legends (ages 7–10) and Robotics Camps (ages 7–12). Camps run 9:30am to 3:30pm with extended hours available at selected venues.

* Coding, robotics, Minecraft, Roblox, DJing and stop-motion animation camps
* Suitable for children aged 5–12 years
* 9:30am–3:30pm (drop-off from 9am, pick-up until 3:45pm)
* Extended hours 8am–5pm available at selected venues
* Use code WOS25 when booking to save $25 on your child's camp
seoTitle: Tech & Creative Holiday Camps Sydney | Code Camp Ages 5–12 | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Week-long holiday camps for kids 5–12 covering coding, robotics, Minecraft, Roblox and more at Sydney locations. Use code WOS25 to save $25.

title: Ashfield Mall Kids Science Workshops
description: Hands-on science fun for little experimenters! Kids mix, fizz and create their way through experiments like bath bombs, slime, perfumes and lava lamps.
longDescription:
Get ready for science that bubbles, fizzes and glows! These school holiday workshops at Ashfield Mall let kids roll up their sleeves and dive into hands-on experiments they can actually take home.

What kids will do:
- Make their own bath bombs
- Create slime and perfumes
- Build a lava lamp
- Explore chemical reactions in a fun, safe way

Brought to you by the team at Ashfield Mall, these popular workshops sell out fast — bookings are essential. Located opposite Kmart inside the centre.
address: Ashfield Mall, Corner of Liverpool Road & Brown Street, Ashfield NSW 2131
seoTitle: Ashfield Mall Kids Science Workshops – School Holiday Science Fun Sydney
seoDescription: Kids make bath bombs, slime, perfumes and lava lamps at Ashfield Mall these school holidays. Ages 4+, just $5 per child. Book now on Eventbrite.

title: Featherdale Wildlife Park
description: Get nose-to-nose with wombats, hand-feed kangaroos and spot koalas up close at one of Sydney's best wildlife parks — a guaranteed hit with kids of every age.
longDescription:
Featherdale Wildlife Park in Doonside is one of the best places in Sydney to get up close with Australian animals. With over 1,700 animals across 260 species, it's a hands-on wildlife experience the whole family will love.

Highlights include:
- Hand-feed kangaroos and wallabies
- See koalas, wombats and Tasmanian devils
- Meet reptiles and birds in walk-through aviaries
- Up-close encounters with native Australian wildlife
- Perfect for all ages including toddlers and babies
seoTitle: Featherdale Wildlife Park Sydney – Meet Kangaroos, Koalas & More
seoDescription: Hand-feed kangaroos, meet koalas and spot wombats at Featherdale Wildlife Park in Western Sydney. Open daily, great for all ages.

title: Luna Park Sydney
description: Rides, fairy floss and harbour views — Luna Park is Sydney's most iconic family fun destination right on the water at Milsons Point.
longDescription:
Luna Park Sydney has been delighting families since 1935 and sits in one of the most spectacular locations in the world — right on the harbour at Milsons Point with sweeping views of the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House.

What's on offer:
- Classic rides and thrill rides for all ages
- Toddler and junior rides for little ones
- Carnival games and fairy floss
- Stunning harbour and bridge views
- Special school holiday events and entertainment
- Combine with a ferry ride for extra fun
seoTitle: Luna Park Sydney – Iconic Rides & Harbour Views for the Whole Family
seoDescription: Rides, fairy floss and Sydney Harbour views at Luna Park Milsons Point. Fun for toddlers to teens, open school holidays and weekends.

title: Centennial Parklands – Family Outdoor Fun
description: 580 acres of beautiful parkland in the Eastern Suburbs with playgrounds, cycling, duck ponds, picnic spots and wide open spaces — free to explore any day.
longDescription:
Centennial Parklands is one of Sydney's most beloved green spaces, covering 580 acres right in the heart of the Eastern Suburbs. It's a perfect free day out for families at any time of year.

Things to do:
- Visit the duck and goose ponds
- Free playgrounds for different age groups
- Hire bikes and pedal cars (small fee)
- Wide open lawns for a picnic
- Birdwatching and nature walks
- Seasonal events including Easter egg hunts and summer concerts
- Horse riding nearby (paid)
address: Centennial Park, Oxford Street, Centennial Park NSW 2021
seoTitle: Centennial Parklands Sydney – Free Family Day Out in the Eastern Suburbs
seoDescription: Free playgrounds, duck ponds, cycling and wide open spaces at Centennial Parklands in Sydney's Eastern Suburbs. Perfect for all ages.

title: Sydney Zoo – Western Sydney's Wild Adventure
description: Come face to face with giraffes, gorillas, hippos and hundreds more animals at Sydney Zoo in Bungarribee Park — a brand new world-class zoo in Western Sydney.
longDescription:
Sydney Zoo opened in 2019 in Bungarribee Park, Blacktown, and is Western Sydney's first major zoo. It's a stunning, purpose-built facility where animals live in large, naturalistic habitats.

What you'll see:
- Giraffes and African savannah animals
- Western lowland gorillas
- Hippos and crocodiles
- Australian wildlife including koalas and wombats
- Over 100 species in total

Good to know:
- Located next to Eastern Creek Raceway — easy to find
- Plenty of parking
- Cafe and picnic areas on site
- Great value family tickets available
address: Bungarribee Park, Great Western Highway, Blacktown NSW 2148
seoTitle: Sydney Zoo Western Sydney – Giraffes, Gorillas & More at Bungarribee Park
seoDescription: Meet giraffes, gorillas, hippos and over 100 species at Sydney Zoo in Blacktown. A world-class wildlife experience for the whole family.

title: Taronga Zoo
description: Meet over 4,000 animals with stunning Harbour views. A Sydney classic that never gets old — from giraffes to gorillas, there's wonder at every turn.
longDescription:
Taronga Zoo is one of Sydney's most iconic family destinations, home to more than 4,000 animals across 350 species. Set on the shores of Sydney Harbour with breathtaking views of the Opera House and Harbour Bridge, a visit here combines world-class wildlife with unforgettable scenery.

* Over 4,000 animals across 350+ species
* Stunning views over Sydney Harbour
* Daily keeper talks and animal encounters
* Sky Safari cable car included with entry
* Accessible via ferry from Circular Quay
seoTitle: Taronga Zoo Sydney | Family Day Out | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Visit Taronga Zoo and meet over 4,000 animals with stunning Harbour views. One of Sydney's best family days out.

title: SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium
description: Walk through glass tunnels surrounded by sharks, rays and thousands of fish. The dugong exhibit is a firm family favourite in the heart of Darling Harbour.
longDescription:
SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium at Darling Harbour is home to over 13,000 animals including sharks, dugongs, rays and Australia's biggest living coral display. Kids love walking through the underwater glass tunnels as sharks glide overhead.

* Walk-through underwater glass tunnels with sharks and rays
* Australia's largest living coral display
* Dugong and penguin exhibits
* Daily feeding shows and guided tours
* Right in Darling Harbour — easy to combine with other CBD activities
seoTitle: SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium | Family Activity Darling Harbour | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Walk through glass tunnels surrounded by sharks and rays at SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium in Darling Harbour. Great for all ages.

title: Powerhouse Museum
description: Science, technology, design and culture under one roof. Interactive exhibits keep kids engaged for hours, with something new to discover every visit.
longDescription:
The Powerhouse Museum is Sydney's premier museum of science, technology, design and culture. With hundreds of interactive exhibits across multiple floors, it's one of the few Sydney attractions where the kids genuinely won't want to leave.

* Free general admission
* Interactive STEM and design exhibits
* Space exploration, trains, and engineering displays
* Special school holiday programs
* Located in Ultimo, a short walk from Darling Harbour
seoTitle: Powerhouse Museum Sydney | Free Family Activity | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Free entry to Sydney's best science and technology museum. Interactive exhibits for kids of all ages in Ultimo.

title: Darling Quarter Playground
description: One of Sydney's best free playgrounds in the heart of Darling Harbour. Giant climbing nets, water play, sandpits and adventure equipment across multiple zones.

title: Australian Museum
description: Australia's oldest museum with dinosaur skeletons, Egyptian mummies and stunning natural history exhibits. Kids love the Dinosaurs exhibition and Discovery Centre.
longDescription:
The Australian Museum in Sydney is the country's oldest natural history museum. With world-class exhibitions covering dinosaurs, ancient Egypt, Pacific cultures and Australian wildlife, it's a full-day experience for the whole family.

* Dinosaur fossils and skeleton displays
* Egyptian mummies and ancient artefacts
* Interactive Discovery Centre for children
* Regular school holiday events and workshops
* Located in the heart of the CBD near Hyde Park
seoTitle: Australian Museum Sydney | Family Day Out | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Explore dinosaurs, Egyptian mummies and natural history at the Australian Museum in Sydney's CBD. Great for school-age kids.

title: Royal Botanic Garden Sydney
description: Sydney's oldest park on the Harbour foreshore. Download the free scavenger hunt activity sheet and spot birds, bugs and beautiful plants as you explore.

title: Bondi Beach
description: Sydney's most iconic beach is perfect for a family day out. Build sandcastles, splash in the shallows, watch the surfers and grab a bite at the beachside cafes.

title: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
description: A stunning 6km clifftop walk past ocean pools, headlands and beaches. Kids love stopping at Bronte and Clovelly — a memorable Sydney morning for the whole family.

title: Balmoral Beach
description: A calm harbour beach with a netted swimming area — perfect for toddlers and young swimmers. Grassy lawns, a rotunda, and beachside cafe make it ideal for a long lazy family afternoon.

title: Sydney Olympic Park
description: Miles of cycling paths, splash-pad water play, picnic areas and adventure playgrounds at the site of the 2000 Olympics. A great full-day destination with free parking.
address: 1 Showground Road, Sydney Olympic Park NSW 2127

title: Parramatta Park
description: 130 hectares of heritage parkland surrounding Australia's oldest Government House. Playgrounds, open lawns, duck ponds and historic ruins for a wonderful family escape.

title: Camperdown Memorial Rest Park
description: A beloved Inner West gem with one of Sydney's best playgrounds — flying foxes, climbing towers, rope bridges and a huge sandpit beneath massive Moreton Bay fig trees.

title: Birchgrove Park
description: A charming harbour-side park in Balmain with a great playground, grassy oval and stunning water views. The local pool and ferry wharf make it perfect for a full family day.

title: Lane Cove National Park
description: Hire a canoe, spot wildlife and explore scenic river trails just minutes from the city. Excellent picnic areas and bush camping for adventurous families.
address: Lady Game Drive, Chatswood West NSW 2067

title: Manly Surf School
description: Qualified instructors teach kids to ride waves on one of the world's most famous beaches. Beginner lessons run on weekends and are suitable from age 5.

title: North Head Sanctuary
description: Walk among wild wallabies and bandicoots on a former quarantine station at the tip of Manly headland. Spectacular coastal views and unique wildlife make this memorable.
address: North Head Scenic Drive, Manly NSW 2095

title: Sydney Tower Eye
description: Soar to the top of Sydney's tallest building for 360° views stretching to the Blue Mountains. The 4D cinema experience brings the city's history to life in stunning detail.
address: Level 5, Westfield Sydney, 188 Pitt Street, Sydney NSW 2000

title: Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park
description: Discover ancient Aboriginal rock art, towering waterways and spectacular views across Broken Bay. The West Head Lookout walk is family-friendly and utterly breathtaking.

title: Ryde Aquatic Leisure Centre
description: An excellent aquatic centre with a thrilling waterslide, outdoor leisure pool with beach entry, indoor lap pool and toddler splash zone. Great value for a full family day.
address: Corner Devlin & Pittwater Road, Ryde NSW 2112

title: Hyde Park Barracks Museum
description: Step inside Australia's convict past with immersive exhibits, artefacts and interactive displays in a UNESCO World Heritage listed building. Kids are fascinated by daily convict life.
address: Queens Square, Macquarie Street, Sydney NSW 2000

title: Circus Arts Sydney
description: Learn juggling, acrobatics, aerial silk and clowning in Rozelle's legendary big top. Regular kids' workshops inspire confidence, creativity and co-ordination in a totally unique way.

title: Fairfield Adventure Park
description: An enormous free adventure playground with flying foxes, water play, skate ramps and climbing structures set along Prospect Creek. One of Western Sydney's best-kept family secrets.

title: Bounce Inc Trampoline Park
description: Walls of trampolines, foam pits, dodgeball courts and high-performance zones. Guaranteed to burn energy and deliver big smiles for bouncy kids of all ages.

title: Glebe Markets
description: Sydney's most eclectic weekend market transforms Glebe Public School into a wonderland of vintage finds, handmade goods and street food. A relaxed Saturday morning for the whole family.
address: Glebe Public School, Derby Place, Glebe NSW 2037

title: Blue Mountains: Echo Point & Three Sisters
description: See the iconic Three Sisters and gaze across millions of years of geology from one of Australia's most spectacular lookouts. A stunning and free day trip from Sydney.
